comparison.objective: Steer a live laser through two mirrors while using a beam block; candidate performs connector depinning.
comparison.physical_skill: Optical alignment and safe occlusion during mirror placement versus contact-rich insertion and bimanual extraction force control.
comparison.success_condition: Requires a valid two-reflection beam path without unsafe exposure and all objects released; candidate requires selective physical extraction without damage. Candidate numerical force/damage limits remain missing.
comparison.reason: The laser task tests geometric optical alignment, not mechanical retention release.
